known_limits: MAXVAL 1/2 are rejected by the reference executable

For MAXVAL<128 with NEAR>0 these vectors use explicit legal thresholds/RESET. The legacy reference implicit threshold defaults differ from final T.87 C.5; they are not treated as standard-default evidence.

coverage: Synthetic grayscale 2..16-bit MAXVAL cases; not full T.87 certification. MAXVAL 1/2 are excluded because this reference tool rejects alphabet sizes below four.
